_purpose: The library's shelves: the subjects it is a library about, in one file read by the front page's card row (scripts/build-frontpage.js, the jumbo-cards fragment), by the viewer's landing and sidebar (scripts/generate-site.js, site-assets/site.js) and by the reader's shelf pages (site-assets/reader.js, #shelf:<id>). A shelf has a title and a line (and, when the front page card needs a shorter one, a card line and a thumb). It points: at the documents to start with, at the books and reading lists on it, at the folders (the numbered collections) that sit on it, and at the one place outside the library it opens onto. It does not explain. scripts/generate-site.js validates every path against HEAD, every list against spine.json, every folder against _meta.json and every book against books/. DRAFT: the titles and lines are Cowork's wording (1 October 2026) from the author's list of subjects — EGPT itself, the history, Ulam / von Neumann / Rota, the Singularity, the mathematics, the physics — and from the card row the seat sketched; every one waits on the author's pass.
